english.title: Ride a cycle on a road / bridle way / footpath without reasonable consideration for others
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) rode a cycle on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD - see Note (iii) in Notes field..) at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), without reasonable consideration for other persons using the road
english.legislation: Contrary to section 29 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) See also offence wording: H3011.
(ii) "Road" includes a "bridleway" and a "footpath" as section 192 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 includes "highway" within the definition of "road" and sections 328 and 329 of the Highway Act 1980 includes "bridleway" and "footpath" within meaning of "highway".
(iii) This offence is eligible for a Fixed Penalty under Part 3 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 from the 24th February 2025 due to SI 2025/68.
